roles.on: page, previous and next controls when they navigate
roles.note: Buttons instead, when they change state in place.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.values: localized "pagination", made unique when there are several

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.values: localized "page 3"; previous and next need a text name, not an arrow glyph

attributes.name: aria-disabled
attributes.on: previous on the first page, next on the last
attributes.note: Keep the element focusable so its position is discoverable.

keyboard.action: Move through previous, the page links and next in page order.
Follow the focused link (go to that page).
Activate the focused control when it is a button.

focus.entry: Each control is a tab stop.
focus.restore: After an in-place page change, focus stays on the activated control (or moves to the start of the new results when the control disappears); it must not be lost to the document body.
focus.tabStops: One per rendered control; the ellipsis is not focusable.

variants: load more (a button; see feed for endless lists)
data.notes: No arrow-key bindings, so nothing is direction-sensitive in the keyboard contract. RTL is entirely visual here: "previous" is on the right with a right-pointing chevron and "next" on the left with a left-pointing one (icon mirroring), page numbers run right-to-left and use the locale's digits. Some libraries offer optional ArrowLeft/ArrowRight page shortcuts; if added they must mirror, and they must not be bound at page level where they would steal caret keys.
